name: Christian Dean Secret Tone Up Sun Cream 70ml
description:
Christian Dean Secret Tone-Up Sun Cream 70ml
Made in Korea | SPF50+ PA+++

Protect, brighten, and nourish your skin with Christian Dean Secret Tone-Up Sun Cream. This light pink cream not only provides superior sun protection but also enhances your skin tone and texture, making it ideal as a makeup base. Enriched with Glutathione, Vitamin C, 12 herbal complexes, Galactomisse, and Hyaluronic Acid, it delivers hydration, vitality, and a radiant complexion.

Key Features:

High Sun Protection: SPF50+ PA+++ shields against harmful UVA and UVB rays.

Tone-Up & Brightening: Light pink formulation gives a lively, radiant skin tone.

Nourishing Ingredients: Glutathione, Vitamin C, and herbal complexes soothe and revitalize skin.

Hydration: Galactomisse and Hyaluronic Acid provide long-lasting moisture.

Makeup Base: Enhances skin color and texture for a flawless finish.

Versatile Use: Ideal for daily wear, beach trips, or outdoor activities.

Made in Korea
